target.steam: independent target; no Switch writer inheritance

resolution: resolve current PlayerHouses entry by current-save PlayerHouseIndex when supplied and require HouseItemID equality
without PlayerHouseIndex, HouseItemID resolution is allowed only when exactly one current-save entry matches
require four unique Room.WallGridIDs keyed by WallPosition 0..3

activeWallIdentity.currentSaveBinding: Room.WallGridIDs is keyed by the same WallPosition enum
activeWallIdentity.wandRule: Current Wall resolves to WallPosition; active wall GridID is a current-save locator and must agree with Room.WallGridIDs[position] when both are available.
failClosed: active GridID does not map uniquely within the current room

scopes.CURRENT_WALL: WallPosition oneof present; invoke helper once for that WallPosition
scopes.ALL_WALLS: WallPosition oneof absent; native code enumerates all WallPosition values

mapSemantics.Wallpapers: protobuf MapField<int,int> keyed by WallPosition; map ordering has no semantic identity
mapSemantics.WallpaperOffsetById: protobuf MapField<int,float> keyed by Wallpaper ItemID; one room-level offset is shared by every wall using that wallpaper ItemID

perWallHelper: read old wallpaper with Wallpapers.TryGetValue(wallPosition); absent key behaves as default old ItemID 0
if existing wallpaper equals target, that wall is unchanged
if displaced old ItemID is no longer used by any wall, remove WallpaperOffsetById[oldItemID] if present
wallpaper.targetOffsetPolicy: preserve existing target WallpaperOffsetById entry or absence; ChangePlayerHouseWallpaper does not synthesize a target offset

wallpaperOffset.productUse: read/projection and exact companion-cleanup semantics only for DEC-UX-241..242
wallpaperOffset.note: No standalone offset control is added by this contract. A later product decision may consume the proven native transaction under a separately bounded writer contract.

atomicDraftTransactions.flooring: one Room.Flooring replacement is one Undo/Redo transaction
atomicDraftTransactions.currentWallWallpaper: selected Wallpapers[WallPosition] set plus any stale displaced WallpaperOffsetById removal commit atomically
atomicDraftTransactions.allWallsWallpaper: all changed Wallpapers[0..3] entries plus every resulting stale displaced WallpaperOffsetById removal are computed from one pre-state and commit atomically; partial apply is forbidden
atomicDraftTransactions.ordinaryPlacedObjectSelection: separate domain; Room Finish never masquerades as GridObject selection

definitionAndOwnershipPolicy.definition: current game database item must resolve as TrimmingItemData / native TrimmingItemType required by operation
definitionAndOwnershipPolicy.ownership: native room finish requires ProfilePlayer.HasItem(item,1) for Flooring and Wallpaper
definitionAndOwnershipPolicy.consumption: none observed; applying room finish does not decrement ownership or inventory
definitionAndOwnershipPolicy.premiumEntitlement: never edited or granted by this contract
definitionAndOwnershipPolicy.unavailableOrUnowned: fail closed as not eligible for the operation; do not synthesize ownership

saveLayer.blocker: 01A transaction-foundation v1.0 target validation only supports GRID_OBJECT and GRID_OBJECT_SET under World.GridCollection.
saveLayer.requestedShape: extend existing WRITE_CANDIDATE with exact PLAYER_HOUSE_ROOM target identity; no generic path writer

runtimeAcceptance.why: Native transaction semantics and current-save persistence are confirmed, but Wand verified-export acceptance for offline room-field mutation has not yet been exercised through the 01A candidate pipeline and cold reload.
frozenMinimumAfterUpstream: one exact-build Flooring candidate changing only Room.Flooring; verify load, normal save, full exit, cold relaunch, same target room identity and unchanged inventory/ownership

one exact-build ALL_WALLS Wallpaper candidate with at least two displaced wallpaper ItemIDs and at least one displaced offset entry; verify changed Wallpapers entries, exact stale-offset removal, no target-offset synthesis, normal save, full exit and cold relaunch
restore exact original backup and confirm load
runtimeAcceptance.rationale: CURRENT_WALL uses the same confirmed native per-wall helper and the same serialized map entry shape exercised by ALL_WALLS; the oneof scope selection is statically confirmed in the exact current binary.
